slot.brief: Find the value(s) of a parameter making two vectors collinear, then use it for a dot/cross product computation.

stem: The vectors $\vec a=\lambda\hat i+2\hat j-4\hat k$ and $\vec b=3\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k$ are collinear. Find $\vec a\cdot\vec b$.

verdicts.working: Collinearity gives \(\vec a=2\vec b\) from the second components; the third components agree, so \(\lambda=6\). Thus \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=2(3^2+1^2+(-2)^2)=28\).

working:
Collinearity: $\dfrac{\lambda}{3}=\dfrac{2}{1}=\dfrac{-4}{-2}=2\Rightarrow\lambda=6$; $\vec a\cdot\vec b=6(3)+2(1)+(-4)(-2)=28$.

Independent check: Collinearity gives \(\vec a=2\vec b\) from the second components; the third components agree, so \(\lambda=6\). Thus \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=2(3^2+1^2+(-2)^2)=28\).
